title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented controls are supported. Both API calls match their references, and targeted searches found no documented switch dedicated to the agent node or automation for its human-assistance setting.

claims.claim: An agent node hands a workflow step to an AI agent that can reason.
claims.quote: The agent node lets a flow hand a step over to an AI agent that can reason, call tools, and pull from knowledge sources before returning a result.
